source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
observations: Range 0..25 step 10 produces two complete classes, 0..10 and 10..20; numbered empty rows are not additional classes.
301/10 exceeds 30 steps and reports Range ERROR even though floor(301/10)=30. 300/10 is accepted.
EXE/OK on a range parameter opens empty input; empty EXE ignored. Syntax error preserves draft and field. RIGHT/SETTINGS ignored on errors.
In the count table EXE/OK without draft opens the statistics menu. Empty mean raises Math ERROR, dismissal returns to counts.
Fractional frequencies accepted, negative frequencies clamp to zero. Count selection wraps at first/last.
An error at count 30 preserves draft 1+, DEL+EXE stores 1; mean then equals class midpoint 295.
